notes: This contract pins Umbra's opt-in, non-installable IEEE 1516.1-2025 receive-order attribute-update development slice to the exact C++ Update Attribute Values and Reflect Attribute Values surfaces exported by the Requirements Lab. It verifies only official signatures, declared exception sets, adapter symbols, and a real Catch2 selector. The slice accepts only the non-timestamped, non-region overload; validates source ownership and FOM attribute definitions; groups each accepted request into FOM-transportation passels; projects each passel at the recipient's currently known class and subscription; suppresses the sender; rechecks eligibility immediately before delivery; preserves tag, producer, and mandatory standard transportation data; and dispatches through immediate or evoked callbacks with a null sent-region pointer. Timestamped/retraction delivery, regions/DDM, update-rate reduction, ownership transfer, custom transportation implementation, FOM sharing-policy enforcement, save/restore, remote transport, packaging, catalog evidence, and conformance remain outside this slice.
